quadrat.gloss: (metal type, obsolete) A quad; a blank metal block used to fill space in lines of type.

quagmire.gloss: A swampy, soggy area of ground.

quality.gloss: (countable) Something that differentiates a thing or person.

quantum gravity.gloss: (quantum physics) A branch of theoretical physics aiming to unite quantum mechanics with general relativity.

quantum mechanics.gloss: (physics) The branch of physics which studies matter and energy at the level of atoms and other elementary particles, and substitutes probabilistic mechanisms in place of classical Newtonian ones.

quantum number.gloss: (quantum mechanics) One of certain integers or half-integers that specify the state of a quantum mechanical system (such as an electron in an atom).

quantum theory.gloss: (physics) A theory developed in the early 20th century, according to which nuclear and radiation phenomena can be explained by assuming that energy only occurs in discrete amounts called quanta.
